from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title_text = "The Solution: The Cycloid"
        lecture_lines = [
            "The fastest path is an inverted cycloid curve.",
            "A cycloid is traced by a point on a rolling wheel.",
            "Its parametric equations balance path length and acceleration.",
            "Gravity accelerates the object most efficiently along this arc.",
            "This curve is the unique solution to the Brachistochrone problem."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # A wheel (#D3D3D3) appears and rolls along a flat ceiling line.
        ceiling_start = self.grid["A1"]
        ceiling_end = self.grid["A6"]
        ceiling = Line(ceiling_start, ceiling_end, color=WHITE)
        
        radius = 0.4
        wheel_start_center = [self.grid["A1"][0] + 0.5, self.grid["A1"][1] - radius, 0]
        wheel_circ = Circle(radius=radius, color="#D3D3D3")
        wheel_circ.move_to(wheel_start_center)
        spoke = Line(wheel_circ.get_center(), wheel_circ.get_top(), color="#D3D3D3")
        wheel_group = VGroup(wheel_circ, spoke)
        
        self.play(Create(ceiling), FadeIn(wheel_group))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # A red dot (#FF0000) on the rim traces an arc as the wheel rolls.
        dot = Dot(radius=0.08, color="#FF0000")
        dot.move_to(wheel_circ.get_top())
        
        theta_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        def update_wheel_motion(obj):
            t = theta_tracker.get_value()
            cx = wheel_start_center[0] + radius * t
            cy = wheel_start_center[1]
            obj[0].move_to([cx, cy, 0])
            obj[1].put_start_and_end_on(
                [cx, cy, 0],
                [cx + radius * np.sin(t), cy + radius * np.cos(t), 0]
            )

        def update_dot_motion(obj):
            t = theta_tracker.get_value()
            cx = wheel_start_center[0] + radius * t
            cy = wheel_start_center[1]
            # Point starts at contact (top) at t=0
            obj.move_to([cx + radius * np.sin(t), cy + radius * np.cos(t), 0])

        wheel_group.add_updater(update_wheel_motion)
        dot.add_updater(update_dot_motion)
        
        # Tracing the path in vibrant light blue (#00FFFF)
        trace = TracedPath(dot.get_center, stroke_color="#00FFFF", stroke_width=4)
        
        self.add(dot, trace)
        # Roll across (one full rotation)
        self.play(theta_tracker.animate.set_value(TAU), run_time=5, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # The full cycloid path is drawn in a vibrant light blue (#00FFFF).
        # Create a static ParametricFunction to replace the trace
        cycloid_path = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([
                wheel_start_center[0] + radius * t + radius * np.sin(t),
                wheel_start_center[1] + radius * np.cos(t),
                0
            ]),
            t_range=[0, TAU],
            color="#00FFFF"
        )
        
        # Remove dynamic elements
        wheel_group.remove_updater(update_wheel_motion)
        dot.remove_updater(update_dot_motion)
        self.remove(trace, dot)
        self.add(cycloid_path)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(wheel_group), FadeOut(ceiling))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # The curve is inverted to match the sliding path between points.
        # Shift to center area and scale up for emphasis
        slide_version = cycloid_path.copy()
        self.place_in_area(slide_version, "B1", "E6", scale_factor=1.6)
        
        self.play(Transform(cycloid_path, slide_version))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # The label 'Cycloid' (#FFD700) appears next to the final shape.
        label = Text("Cycloid", color="#FFD700", font_size=36)
        label.next_to(cycloid_path, UP, buff=0.4)
        
        self.play(Write(label))
        self.wait(3)
